name: STS2 Host Observer
author: inggom
description: Run a STS2 multiplayer lobby as a dedicated host — open a session, watch up to 4 clients play, never sit in a player slot yourself. Toggle via Sts2HostObserver.Runtime.ObserverState.Enabled (default false). Pre-alpha: scaffold + core patches only; lobby UI / character select null-safety still pending live testing.
